messages:
sidney_lee: Hey team — Sidney here, just finished my first half-day! Quick notes/questions: laptop arrived but need help with the docking station (USB-C -> 2xDP). Also trying to get VPN + Okta set up. Who's the right person to ping? Also two fun facts to distract from setup: I collect vintage socks and I can recite the alphabet backwards. :socks: :backward:  

aisha_ng: Welcome Sidney!! :tada: Ping me for the dock, I have the adapter list. For Okta/VPN, start with the infra runbook (link below) and then DM infra if anything fails.  

aisha_ng: infra runbook: https://redwood.infra/docs/vpn-okta-setup  

tom_holland: hey @sidney_lee — I handled a similar dock last week, can bring a spare USB-C cable to your desk in case it's flaky. If you want remote help later i can screenshare.  

infra-bot: Automated message: "Onboarding checklist" assigned to sidney_lee. Steps: create GH account, add to slack groups, grant vault access, configure VPN. See https://redwood.tools/onboarding  

sidney_lee: thanks all! @aisha_ng I'll try the runbook now. @tom_holland super appreciate the spare cable.  

rebecca_m: Also quick tip — if your display flickers, try `xrandr --auto` (works for most docking chips).  

oliver: FYI engineering channel has a pinned post with starter issues if you want to jump on something low-friction this week: #eng-starter-issues  

sidney_lee: perfect — added myself to #eng-starter-issues. Also leaving a tiny poll: coffee or tea? (important team cohesion question) :coffee: :tea:  

aisha_ng: coffee for sure.  

tom_holland: coffee, but big fan of oat milk alternatives.  

rebecca_m: tea + biscotti. welcome again! :wave:  

sidney_lee: thanks everyone — i'll update once VPN/Okta done. see you at the intro lunch later. :salad:
